system.description:
● Branch Sect (Specific Sect): This individual’s sect is incredibly similar to a specific sect with whom they are currently considered as ‘Different’. Treat them as part of that sect for the purposes of multi-casting penalties. Cannot be bought by nonDisparate sects.

●● Compatible Sect: This individual’s sect is compatible in its methods with a certain faction outside of its own. Treat them as ‘Different’ instead of ‘Radically Different’ with the selected sect faction. Cannot be bought by non-Disparate sects.
